extraction.Name: William Bridgeman
extraction.Recorded patent: The instrument was recorded August 11, 1923 by William Bridgeman
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to T.C. Montgomery for $1500; conveyed by deed to Winnie M. Keller for $1.00 and other valuable consideration, subject to encumbrances of record
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739681 issued; a receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee April 3, 1920; mortgage to T.C. Montgomery dated August 10, 1923; conveyance to Winnie M. Keller dated November 21, 1923; land described as the north half of section 15, township 102, range 77; document received at Rosebud, S. Dak., June 1929
